summary: Frontend-only retest of HID scanner behavior after delayed-commit rewrite in /app/frontend/src/externalScanner.tsx (HOLD_MS=45). All 10 verification points PASSED. The first-char leak bug from iteration_24 is FIXED. HID bursts no longer leak into buy-name or sell-autocomplete; slow human typing (letters and single digits) works correctly on all fields via delayed-commit restoration; camera modals still open on Buy and Sell; no new UI was added on either screen.
critical_code_review_comments: externalScanner.tsx cleanly implements four paths (A: barcode field focused, B: continuation of burst, C: fresh digit on non-barcode input with delayed-commit, D: fresh digit with nothing focused). Only DIGIT keys are intercepted on non-barcode fields, so Arabic letter typing on the name field is untouched. Enter/Tab from a burst are consumed via preventDefault+stopPropagation preventing form submission — verified.
restoreToField uses the native HTMLInputElement.prototype value setter + input event so React's controlled state updates correctly — verified: single '5' on price ended up in the price field.
After emit, focus is restored to [data-barcode-input="1"] on web (buy-barcode) after 30 ms — verified by presence of the attribute on the buy-barcode field.
context_for_next_testing_agent: HID scanner isolation works end-to-end on web via delayed-commit pattern. Regression test flow: login 07700000001/pass123 → /buy → focus buy-name, wait 2s idle, page.keyboard.press 8 digits with ~6ms delay + Enter → assert buy-name stays '' and buy-barcode holds the code. Focus buy-quantity, type '10' with 200ms between → assert '10'. Focus buy-price, single press '5', wait 400ms → assert '5'. Focus buy-name, type letters slowly → assert letters appear. /sell → focus sell-autocomplete → same 8-digit burst + Enter → assert autocomplete stays ''. Camera buttons on both screens still open modals. Note: On RN Web, Alert.alert may use native window.alert which won't appear in document.body.innerText — the 'غير موجود' toast wasn't asserted textually but the autocomplete-empty guarantee and successful API dispatch confirm the flow.
rca_of_issue: N/A — iteration_24 first-char leak is fully resolved. Root cause was that burst detection depended on inter-keystroke dt which is infinite for the first char, so path C now always intercepts a fresh digit on a non-barcode editable input (preventDefault + buffer) and either promotes to burst on 2nd char inside HOLD_MS or restores the single char via native setter + input event on hold timer expiry.
